description: Fast re-check after you fix something: re-measures the page and tells you what was FIXED, what is STILL OPEN and what is NEW since your last audit of it, with the score change. Use this inside a fix loop instead of re-running the full critique: it skips the written patch list and the build guidance, so it comes back in seconds. Needs the same url you audited before (critique_design or polish_and_prove); the first re-check of a page saves the starting point. For screenshots and written fixes call critique_design; for the client before-and-after call polish_and_prove.

description.description: What the business is, in a sentence. Pass the same one you gave the first audit so the site type stays the same.

direction.description: Direction pack id the page implements, if it was built from get_design_direction

source.description: Raw HTML of the page, when the URL cannot be fetched (for example behind bot protection). Pass url too so it is compared with the right earlier audit.

url.description: Public URL of the page you already audited and have now changed

name: recheck_design
